newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK BABY LAND TOYS STARTS TRADE JUNE 19.
newsitem.headline: GREEK BABY LAND TOYS STARTS TRADE JUNE 19.

text.p: Greek toys and baby care retailer Baby Land Toys SA makes its trading debut on the Athens bourse's small-cap parallel market on June 19.
Baby Land Toys' shares will trade without daily volatility limits during the first three sessions.
The company went public at 850 drachmas a share and its IPO was oversubscribed 34.83 times.
Baby Land Toys tapped the market for 689 million drachmas with an issue of 810,000 common bearer shares with a par value of 200 drachmas.
IPO proceeds will finance the expansion of its sales network and a new store in Athens' southern suberb of Vari.
Baby Land Toys saw its pretax profit rise 151.8 percent to 501 million drachmas in the fiscal year ending in June 1996 on turnover growth of 42.3 percent to 8.007 billion drachmas.
Management forecast pretax earnings will rise 23 percent to 616 million drachmas in fiscal 1996/97, growing a further 26.5 percent to 779 million in 1997/98.
Shares arising from the IPO are entitled to full dividend for fiscal 1996/97.
The company has not distributed dividends up to 1995/96. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
